items.name: Warm Up in Mount Prospect 2023

venue.name: Mt. Prospect Public Library
venue.address: 10 S. Emerson St, Mount Prospect, IL 60056, USA

items.information:
## This competition takes place on a Monday. Please plan your attendance accordingly.

Come to this competition to get all warmed up before [CubingUSA Nationals 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingUSANationals2023) on Thursday!

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [WCA Competition Tutorial] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf). There is a one guest limit for this competition due to the size of the room. This also means that no outside spectators will be allowed.

Join our [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/2382471798653473/) to get notified when future competitions in the area get announced and to socialize with other speedcubers!

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).

items.information:
This competition is on a **Monday evening** and will only feature blindfolded events. As a result, this competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the [many other competitions happening in Ohio](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list).

Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited.
